## Purpose

Describe the user or research problem addressed by this change.

## Scope

- [ ] The change is limited to one coherent objective.
- [ ] Privacy, safety and evaluation boundaries remain accurate.
- [ ] No measured, synthetic or public-context data has been conflated.

## Verification

- [ ] Python tests pass.
- [ ] Browser-side JavaScript tests pass.
- [ ] Checked-in evaluation results reproduce.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has targeted tests.
- [ ] Keyboard, responsive and reduced-motion behaviour was considered where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots were updated where relevant.

## Evidence

List commands, observed outcomes, screenshots and any remaining limitations.

## Reviewer notes

Identify high-risk assumptions, unresolved questions or areas requiring manual inspection.
